description:
Search available numbers

Searches the number marketplace for numbers that can be bought right now in one country. Nothing is reserved: a listing can disappear between the search and the purchase, so buy promptly and be ready to retry with a different result. Each entry carries the prices, the capabilities and the identifiers a purchase needs, and should be passed back to the purchase endpoint unchanged. The marketplace applies its own rate limit; when it is hit the endpoint answers 429 and the search can be repeated after a short pause.

areaCode.description: Area or city code to search within. Only meaningful for number types that have one, such as `local`.

countryIso.description: Two-letter ISO country code to search in, exactly 2 characters. Take it from the `iso` field of the countries endpoint.

limit.description: Maximum number of listings to return. Must be between 1 and 100; a value outside that range is rejected with 400 rather than clamped.

numberType.description: Restrict the search to one category of number. Omit to let the marketplace decide which categories to return.
